fact: On 8 November 2026 the head of the State Council said the e-litigation system, in pilot operation, was extended to the administrative court for education and the disciplinary court for health, with a Cairo administrative court circuit sitting electronically and disciplinary cases filed fully electronically.
title: رئيس مجلس الدولة: التوسع في التقاضي الإلكتروني يستهدف تحقيق عدالة إدارية ناجزة
